groups.saying_opens: لا تبيعوا الثمر حتى يبدو صلاحه

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad: the Abu Hurayra saying (group 1) and the «قال ابن شهاب حدثني سالم» saying (group 2), kept both per owner ruling 6; group 2 repeats the head up to Ibn Shihab, as the text does
«قراءة عليه وأنا أسمع» is a remark on how the report was read and is left out
The Prophet is the end of both sayings; «أبيه» is a bare relation link (Ibn Umar by the text's own words is not named)
